description: The spoken form of every case in spec/display_vectors.json, for screen readers: one sentence per vector name, generated by tools/gen_spoken_vectors.py and checked by the Python and Swift test suites. Do not edit by hand. It is built from the classified status, never from the rendered lines, and it is never more current than the screen: the age is always spoken, STALE speaks its warning first with no trend word, and NO DATA never speaks a number. 'Nightscout unreachable.' is added when the fetch failed. For polite or passive accessibility channels only; it is not published to Home Assistant or any text-to-speech path.
